notes.title: Wunderdoktor 1.0.2b Hotfix (Achievements should work again)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
in the last patch we did, we accidentally broke the Steam Achievements.
Thanks to a bug report, we could track down the problem and have deployed a patch that should solve the problem.
Sorry for any issues this caused.

EDIT: We just realized that by fixing the Steam Integration, progress you made from January 6th until now has been reset. Saving & loading should be fixed now. We're really sorry if you lost any progress because of this.

notes.title: Wunderdoktor Patch 1.0.2 (Bugfixes)
notes.notes:
Fellow doktors!

We patched the game to version 1.02 and fixed a couple of annoying, sometimes even gamebreaking bugs.

If any of you encounter more bugs, please use the "Report Bug" button in the main menu to send us a report!

Patchlog:

Fixed a bug that messed up the "Ghost Jewel" Challenge in Act 5.
Fixed a gamebreaking bug that occurred when the patient died while the "Feed" overlay faded in or out.
Added bells & saving between the final bosses in Act 5.
Fixed a gamebreaking bug that prevented the Epilogue from showing up.
Fixed a bug where the oven vial wouldn't fill up with ash after a patient died.

notes.title: Wunderdoktor Patch 1.0.1 (Vsync, Instruments reworked, bugfixes)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We just updated the game to version 1.01, these are the changes:

* Added Vsync Toggle in Options Menu
* Reworked some of the "instrument" symptoms to enhance flow
* Changed the "Eternal Sleep" Patient in Act 2 slightly (more slapping)
* Changed some minor dialogues
* Fixed a myriad of other small bugs

We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Slapper / Ghost Hotfix is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone out there who's aready playing the game:

If you encountered a gamebreaking bug in the later half of Act 1 where you had to use the "Slapper", the patient died and you couldn't progress any more:
That's fixed now. Sorry for the inconvenience.

We also reworked the Slapper itself to make it a bit more intuitive: You just have to swipe the tool from left to right (or right to left) at a certain speed and then: SLAP!

Thanks for your patience! Hope you enjoy the game! :)
